cases.inputType: paraphrase of the published household comparison, article timestamp resolves last year
cases.query: 2024년 가구의 1인당 연간 쌀 소비량은 55.8kg으로 전년보다 1.1% 줄었다.
cases.answer: Household per-person annual rice 55.8 kg, YoY -1.1%; not all grains or daily grams.
cases.notes: Physical p5 summary row 49 is under 2024 annual household summary. PDF 7 paragraph 84 contains both values; annual table 2-2 uses 2024 KG and percent (rows 94-99). 55.8 alone is partial for this compound comparison.

cases.inputType: verbatim sentence from the published news article; original scope error retained
cases.query: 식료품 제조업 부문 쌀 소비량은 1년 전보다 6.9%(5만6242톤) 증가한 87만3363톤으로 집계됐다.
cases.answer: Food excluding beverages 584612 t, +4.8% (+26548 t); the article assigned combined food and beverage processing 873363 t/+6.9% to food alone. Correct handling returns food-specific evidence even if the numbers in the article disagree.
cases.notes: Source p11 printed p7 rows 205, 216. Comparing amounts in rows 535-536 needs category headers including the food-only column and calculation of change. The article itself distinguishes the figures in its next sentence.
